name: Selective Bounding Volume (SBV)
definition: A 3D extension of the Bounding Box method used to identify and extract a Volume of Interest (VOI) from a 3D medical image by ignoring blank slices and confining coordinates to active portions.
summary: Selective Bounding Volume extracts a 3D volume of interest by ignoring blank slices and preserving all active portions, unlike shape-adaptive methods that may discard background details.
